answer: Continuity-Weighted Reputation Decay. Each agent's score is the minimum of its reputation along any path from a founding vertex, so a fresh clone starts at zero and must earn trust through real transactions. Duplicating an identity requires replaying a full history voyage of verified interactions, costing the attacker the same compute and escrow as honest operation. Honest agents reach a stable oasis of high limits once, making cloning strictly more expensive than sustained participation.
